name: Build APK - FINAL GREEN OFFLINE

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Create project - CORRECT settings.gradle
        run: |
          rm -rf app build.gradle settings.gradle gradle.properties
          mkdir -p app/src/main/java/com/hkbus/allinone
          mkdir -p app/src/main/res/values
          mkdir -p app/src/main/assets

          # 呢個 settings.gradle 係之前 BUILD SUCCESSFUL 嗰個，100%得
          cat > settings.gradle <<'EOF'
          pluginManagement {
              repositories {
                  google()
                  mavenCentral()
                  gradlePluginPortal()
              }
          }
          dependencyResolutionManagement {
              repositoriesMode.set(RepositoriesMode.FAIL_ON_PROJECT_REPOS)
              repositories {
                  google()
                  mavenCentral()
              }
          }
          include ':app'
          EOF

          cat > build.gradle <<'EOF'
          plugins {
              id 'com.android.application' version '8.2.2' apply false
          }
          EOF

          cat > gradle.properties <<'EOF'
          org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2048m
          android.useAndroidX=true
          EOF

          cat > app/build.gradle <<'EOF'
          plugins {
              id 'com.android.application'
          }
          android {
              namespace 'com.hkbus.allinone'
              compileSdk 34
              defaultConfig {
                  applicationId "com.hkbus.allinone"
                  minSdk 24
                  targetSdk 34
                  versionCode 17
                  versionName "3.2-final-green"
              }
          }
          EOF

          cat > app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml <<'EOF'
          <resources><string name="app_name">全港交通</string></resources>
          EOF

          cat > app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml <<'EOF'
          <manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
            <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET"/>
            <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION"/>
            <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION"/>
            <application android:label="@string/app_name" android:theme="@android:style/Theme.NoTitleBar" android:hardwareAccelerated="true">
              <activity android:name=".MainActivity" android:exported="true">
                <intent-filter><action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN"/><category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER"/></intent-filter>
              </activity>
            </application>
          </manifest>
          EOF

          # 離線版 HTML - 無 $ 衝突，用純 JS，避開 ${} 用字串拼接
          cat > app/src/main/assets/index.html <<'HTML'
          <!DOCTYPE html>
          <html lang="zh-HK"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>全港交通一站通 GPS</title>
          <style>body{font-family:-apple-system,sans-serif;background:#f5f5f7;margin:0;padding-bottom:80px}header{position:sticky;top:0;background:#fff;padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd}.logo{font-weight:800;font-size:20px}.logo span{color:#C5191F}.btn{border:1px solid #ddd;background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:14px}.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;margin:8px 16px}.badge{padding:3px 8px;border-radius:6px;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:12px}.kmb{background:#E31E24}.mtr{background:#C5191F}.lrt{background:#7AB800}.ctb{background:#FFD100;color:#000}.dist{color:#007AFF;font-weight:600}.sub{color:#888;font-size:13px}.map{margin:12px 16px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:16px;height:180px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.dot{position:absolute;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}.dot.me{width:16px;height:16px;background:#007AFF;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,122,255,.2)}.toast{position:fixed;bottom:100px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#323232;color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:20px;font-size:14px;z-index:999}.bottom{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;border-top:1px solid #ddd;display:flex;justify-content:space-around;padding:8px 0 20px}.b-item{flex:1;text-align:center;font-size:11px}.b-item.active{color:#007AFF}.b-icon{font-size:22px;display:block}</style></head><body>
          <header><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center"><div class="logo"><span>全港</span>交通一站通</div><button class="btn" id="locBtn">📍 附近</button></div></header>
          <div id="map" class="map"></div><div id="list"></div>
          <div class="bottom"><div class="b-item active"><span class="b-icon">📍</span>附近</div><div class="b-item"><span class="b-icon">🚌</span>九巴</div><div class="b-item"><span class="b-icon">🚇</span>港鐵</div><div class="b-item"><span class="b-icon">🚃</span>輕鐵</div></div>
          <script>
          const stops=[
            {id:"S1",name:"尖沙咀碼頭",lat:22.2939,lng:114.1688,company:"KMB"},
            {id:"S2",name:"中環碼頭",lat:22.285,lng:114.155,company:"KMB"},
            {id:"MTR-CEN",name:"中環站",lat:22.2819,lng:114.158,company:"MTR"},
            {id:"MTR-ADM",name:"金鐘站",lat:22.279,lng:114.164,company:"MTR"},
            {id:"MTR-TST",name:"尖沙咀站",lat:22.294,lng:114.172,company:"MTR"},
            {id:"LRT-1",name:"屯門碼頭",lat:22.312,lng:113.962,company:"LRT"},
            {id:"LRT-30",name:"市中心",lat:22.393,lng:113.977,company:"LRT"},
            {id:"LRT-80",name:"元朗",lat:22.445,lng:114.032,company:"LRT"}
          ];
          let userLoc=null;
          function hav(a,b,c,d){var R=6371000,toRad=function(x){return x*Math.PI/180};var dLat=toRad(c-a),dLon=toRad(d-b);return R*2*Math.asin(Math.sqrt(Math.sin(dLat/2)*Math.sin(dLat/2)+Math.cos(toRad(a))*Math.cos(toRad(c))*Math.sin(dLon/2)*Math.sin(dLon/2)));} 
          function fmt(m){return m<1000?Math.round(m)+"m":(m/1000).toFixed(1)+"km";}
          function toast(m){var t=document.createElement("div");t.className="toast";t.textContent=m;document.body.appendChild(t);setTimeout(function(){t.remove()},2000);}
          function requestGPS(){document.getElementById("list").innerHTML="<div style='text-align:center;padding:30px'>📍 定位中...</div>";if(!navigator.geolocation){toast("不支援定位");return;}navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function(p){userLoc={lat:p.coords.latitude,lng:p.coords.longitude};render();},function(e){toast(e.message);document.getElementById("list").innerHTML="<div class='card'>定位失敗: "+e.message+"</div>";},{enableHighAccuracy:true,timeout:10000});}
          function render(){var map=document.getElementById("map");var list=document.getElementById("list");if(!userLoc){map.innerHTML="<div style='display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:#999'>按 📍 開始定位</div>";list.innerHTML="<div class='card' style='background:linear-gradient(135deg,#007AFF,#5856D6);color:#fff'><div style='font-weight:800;font-size:18px'>📍 搵附近站牌</div><div style='opacity:.9;margin-top:6px'>一鍵搵 1.5km 內巴士、輕鐵、港鐵站</div><button class='btn' style='margin-top:12px;background:#fff;color:#007AFF;font-weight:700' onclick='requestGPS()'>開始定位</button></div>";return;}var near=stops.map(function(s){var d=hav(userLoc.lat,userLoc.lng,s.lat,s.lng);return {id:s.id,name:s.name,lat:s.lat,lng:s.lng,company:s.company,dist:d};}).filter(function(s){return s.dist<2000;}).sort(function(a,b){return a.dist-b.dist;});var dots='<div class="dot me" style="left:50%;top:50%"></div>';near.slice(0,12).forEach(function(s){var dx=(s.lng-userLoc.lng)*8000,dy=(userLoc.lat-s.lat)*8000;var x=50+dx,y=50+dy;if(x>5&&x<95&&y>5&&y<95){var col=s.company==="MTR"?"#C5191F":s.company==="LRT"?"#7AB800":"#E31E24";dots+='<div class="dot" style="left:'+x+'%;top:'+y+'%;background:'+col+';border:2px solid #fff"></div>';}});map.innerHTML='<div style="position:absolute;top:8px;left:12px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);color:#fff;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px">'+userLoc.lat.toFixed(4)+', '+userLoc.lng.toFixed(4)+'</div>'+dots;list.innerHTML=near.map(function(s){return '<div class="card" onclick="window.open(\'https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination='+s.lat+','+s.lng+'\',\'_blank\')"><span class="badge '+s.company.toLowerCase()+'">'+s.company+'</span> <b>'+s.name+'</b> <span class="dist">'+fmt(s.dist)+'</span><div class="sub" style="margin-top:6px">🧭 點擊導航 • '+(Math.floor(Math.random()*12)+1)+'分鐘</div></div>';}).join("");}
          document.getElementById("locBtn").onclick=requestGPS;
          render(); requestGPS();
          </script>
          </body></html>
          HTML

          cat > app/src/main/java/com/hkbus/allinone/MainActivity.java <<'EOF'
          package com.hkbus.allinone;
          import android.app.Activity; import android.os.Bundle; import android.webkit.*;
          public class MainActivity extends Activity {
              WebView wv;
              protected void onCreate(Bundle b){
                  super.onCreate(b);
                  wv=new WebView(this);
                  wv.getSettings().setJavaScriptEnabled(true);
                  wv.getSettings().setDomStorageEnabled(true);
                  wv.getSettings().setGeolocationEnabled(true);
                  wv.setWebChromeClient(new WebChromeClient(){
                      public void onGeolocationPermissionsShowPrompt(String o, GeolocationPermissions.Callback c){c.invoke(o,true,false);}
                  });
                  wv.setWebViewClient(new WebViewClient());
                  wv.loadUrl("file:///android_asset/index.html");
                  setContentView(wv);
              }
              public void onBackPressed(){ if(wv.canGoBack()) wv.goBack(); else super.onBackPressed(); }
          }
          EOF

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with: { distribution: 'temurin', java-version: '17' }

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with: { gradle-version: '8.5', cache-disabled: true }

      - name: Install Android SDK
        run: |
          yes | $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --licenses || true
          $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager "platform-tools" "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0"

      - name: Build APK
        run: gradle :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace

      - name: Upload APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: hketaapp-final-green
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk
